name: web-payment-method-modal-with-radio-cards-and-stacked-dialog
title: Modal 'Choose a payment method' with three radio cards, a selected grey state, and a Cancel and black Continue footer
whatItIs: A white modal over a second dialog peeking behind, with a bold title, a grey subtitle, a hairline, three rounded radio cards (Credit Card selected in grey, PayPal, Apple Pay) each with an icon, description and radio circle, and a footer with an outlined Cancel and a black Continue.
whatItMeans: Clear and calm; card-style radio options make choices easy to scan.
techniques: Pair outlined Cancel with a black primary.

vocabulary.definition: A selectable card with a radio circle.
A dialog partly hidden behind another.
The bottom row of actions in a dialog.
The chosen option tinted or filled.
